instruction: A cinematic medium shot of a festive outdoor patio. In the center, the man in the white dress shirt (R3) and the woman in the pink dress (R4) share a passionate kiss. The man stands on the left, holding her hand, while the woman stands on the right with her other arm raised high in the air. In the background, a blurred mariachi guitarist wearing a sombrero plays his acoustic guitar. Soft natural daylight illuminates the couple, creating a warm, romantic atmosphere with gentle shadows.
